_meta.description: Local city/county eBike ordinances. All entries verified against official government sources. last_updated field indicates when each entry was last verified.
_meta.disclaimer: Informational only. Verify current laws with official sources before riding.

cities.name: New York City
cities.summary: 15 mph citywide speed limit for eBikes (Class 1-3) effective Oct 24, 2025. Prohibited on sidewalks.

provisions.restrictions: 15 mph limit applies to all e-devices on city streets.

cities.name: Buffalo
cities.summary: NYC's 15 mph rule does NOT apply here. Buffalo follows NY state law. No local eBike ordinances adding restrictions beyond state.

provisions.restrictions: State 3-class system applies.

cities.name: Rochester
cities.summary: Follows NY state 3-class eBike law. No additional local ordinances on file. Genesee Riverway Trail allows Class 1/2.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 restricted from some multi-use paths.

cities.name: Seattle
cities.summary: Helmets required for all ages. 15 mph speed limit on multi-use trails.

provisions.sidewalk_allowed: Class 1/2 allowed; Class 3 prohibited unless no alternative

cities.name: Tacoma
cities.summary: Follows WA state 3-class eBike law. Trail speed limits enforced at 15 mph. Helmets required for all ages per Tacoma Municipal Code.

cities.name: Spokane
cities.summary: Highly restrictive. Banned from parks and multipurpose trails (except shared program).

cities.name: Eugene
cities.summary: Detailed path speed limits. Banned from sidewalks. Min age 16.

cities.name: Portland
cities.summary: Sidewalk riding prohibited in downtown business district.

cities.name: Salem
cities.summary: Oregon state law applies. No additional local eBike restrictions. Willamette River Trail allows Class 1/2.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 restricted from off-street paths.

cities.name: Houston
cities.summary: Follows TX state 3-class eBike law. No city-specific additions. Sidewalk riding generally allowed in non-business areas. Helmets required for under 18.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 restricted to roads; Buffalo Bayou trail allows Class 1/2.

cities.name: San Antonio
cities.summary: Sidewalk riding strictly prohibited citywide. Front white light and rear red light required.

cities.name: Dallas
cities.summary: Follows TX state 3-class law. Katy Trail and Santa Fe Trail: Class 1/2 permitted, 15 mph speed limit enforced.

provisions.restrictions: Trail speed limits 15 mph; Class 3 on roads only.

cities.name: Fort Worth
cities.summary: Follows TX state law. Trinity Trails system permits Class 1/2 eBikes. 15 mph trail speed limit.

provisions.restrictions: Trinity Trails: 15 mph, Class 1/2 only; Class 3 on roadways.

cities.name: Austin
cities.summary: Helmets required for under 18. Sidewalk riding allowed outside business district.

cities.name: Las Vegas
cities.summary: 15 mph speed limit in city facilities and parks. Helmets for minors.

cities.name: Henderson
cities.summary: Prohibits e-motorcycles (no pedals/throttle only). Helmets required for under 18.

cities.name: Reno
cities.summary: Nevada state eBike law applies. Truckee River trail: Class 1/2 permitted with 15 mph limit. Helmets for minors.

provisions.restrictions: Riverside trail system: 15 mph posted limit.

cities.name: Columbus
cities.summary: 20 mph speed limit for all mobility devices. Restricted on streets >35 mph.

cities.name: Cleveland
cities.summary: Ohio Revised Code §4511.522 applies. eBikes treated as bicycles. Towpath Trail allows all classes with 10 mph advisory near pedestrians.

provisions.restrictions: Towpath Trail: 10 mph advisory when pedestrians present.

cities.name: Cincinnati
cities.summary: Ohio state law applies. Little Miami Trail and Ohio River trail allow Class 1/2. Class 3 must use roadways on off-street paths.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 restricted from most off-street paths per trail management.

cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.summary: Class 1 and 2 permitted in bike lanes. Strict enforcement of 750W limits; uncertified mods risk impoundment.

provisions.restrictions: Illegal modifications strictly penalized.

cities.name: San Diego
cities.summary: CA state eBike law applies. Balboa Park and Mission Bay restrict Class 3 eBikes on narrow paths per SDPD guidance.

provisions.restrictions: Balboa Park and Mission Bay: Class 3 prohibited on shared paths.

cities.name: San Jose
cities.summary: CA law applies. Santa Clara County trail system allows Class 1/2. Class 3 restricted to roadways on most off-street trails.

provisions.restrictions: Los Gatos Creek and Guadalupe River trails: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: San Francisco
cities.summary: Check local park signage; East Bay Regional Park District maintains strict rules on Class 3 access on narrow paths.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 e-bikes restricted from coastal trails.

cities.name: Sacramento
cities.summary: CA law applies. American River Parkway (Jedediah Smith Memorial Trail): Class 1 permitted; Class 2/3 must use roadways or follow posted signage.

provisions.restrictions: American River Parkway: Class 2/3 restricted from trail; roadways only.

cities.name: Jacksonville
cities.summary: Florida state eBike law applies. No additional local restrictions. St. Johns River trail network allows Class 1/2.

provisions.restrictions: Trail system: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Miami
cities.summary: Sidewalk riding heavily restricted in business districts and Miami Beach. Must yield to pedestrians.

provisions.restrictions: 10 mph limit if pedestrian within 50 feet.

cities.name: Tampa
cities.summary: FL state law applies. Tampa Riverwalk and Bayshore Boulevard: eBikes limited to 10 mph. Class 3 strongly discouraged on narrow Riverwalk sections.

provisions.restrictions: Riverwalk: 10 mph limit; Class 3 use roads instead.

cities.name: Orlando
cities.summary: Sidewalks allowed in non-business districts. E-bikes prohibited around Lake Eola due to pedestrian volume.

provisions.restrictions: Audible signal required before passing.

cities.name: Chicago
cities.summary: Sidewalks prohibited. Increasing enforcement on high-speed 'e-motos'.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 e-bikes restricted from some lakefront paths.

cities.name: Aurora
cities.summary: Illinois state eBike law applies. No additional local eBike ordinances. Fox River Trail allows Class 1/2.

provisions.restrictions: Fox River Trail: Class 1/2 only; 15 mph advisory.

cities.name: Denver
cities.summary: Class 1 and 2 allowed on most paved multi-use trails. 15 mph speed limit heavily enforced in parks.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 prohibited on multi-use paths unless adjacent to roadway.

cities.name: Colorado Springs
cities.summary: CO state 3-class law applies. Pikes Peak Greenway and Legacy Loop trails allow Class 1/2 at 15 mph. Class 3 restricted to roadways.

provisions.restrictions: Trail system: Class 1/2 only; Class 3 on roads.

cities.name: Boulder
cities.summary: CO state law applies. Boulder Creek Path and extensive trail network allow Class 1/2. Class 3 restricted on most off-street paths. Speed limit 15 mph on paths.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 prohibited on shared-use paths; use roadway.

cities.name: Philadelphia
cities.summary: E-bikes follow PA bicycle laws. Prohibited on sidewalks in business districts.

provisions.restrictions: Pedal-assist only on some trails.

cities.name: Pittsburgh
cities.summary: Pennsylvania eBike law (Act 154, 2020) applies. Three Rivers Heritage Trail allows Class 1/2. Class 3 must use roadways on off-street paths.

provisions.restrictions: Three Rivers Heritage Trail: Class 1/2 only; Class 3 roadway.

cities.name: Boston
cities.summary: E-bikes allowed in bike lanes. Class 3 restricted from some paths.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 must ride on streets.

cities.name: Worcester
cities.summary: MA state eBike law applies. No specific local ordinances. Follows 3-class definitions.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 restricted from shared-use paths.

cities.name: Newark
cities.summary: E-bikes permitted on roadways. Follow state 3-class system.

provisions.restrictions: No local bans on Class 1/2.

cities.name: Jersey City
cities.summary: NJ state law applies. Hudson River Waterfront Walkway allows Class 1/2 with 15 mph advisory near pedestrians.

provisions.restrictions: Hudson Waterfront trail: Class 1/2; 15 mph advisory.

cities.name: New Haven
cities.summary: Helmet required for all ebike riders. Trails have 15 mph limits.

provisions.restrictions: Stricter helmet law per state mandate.

cities.name: Hartford
cities.summary: CT state eBike law applies. Park River Trail and Riverfront Recapture paths allow Class 1/2.

provisions.restrictions: Trail network: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Phoenix
cities.summary: E-bikes allowed on most paved paths. Dirt trail access varies.

provisions.restrictions: Gas-powered bikes banned.

cities.name: Tucson
cities.summary: AZ 3-class law applies. Rillito River Park and Loop trail system: Class 1/2 permitted with 15 mph limit. Pima County restricts Class 3 from most off-street paths.

provisions.restrictions: The Loop trail: Class 1/2 with 15 mph limit; Class 3 on roads.

cities.name: Mesa
cities.summary: Follows AZ state 3-class eBike law. Trail system allows Class 1/2. Class 3 on roadways. No city-specific additions beyond state.

provisions.restrictions: Trail network: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Scottsdale
cities.summary: Scottsdale follows AZ state law. Indian Bend Wash Greenbelt: Class 1/2 allowed, 15 mph limit. McDowell Sonoran Preserve restricts all motorized including Class 3.

provisions.restrictions: McDowell Sonoran Preserve: eBikes prohibited. Greenbelt: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Albuquerque
cities.summary: Class 1 and 2 allowed on multi-use trails. Class 3 on roads only.

provisions.restrictions: Trail limits at 15 mph.

cities.name: Salt Lake City
cities.summary: Class 1/2 permitted on paved paths. 15 mph speed limit enforced.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 prohibited on off-street paths.

cities.name: Provo
cities.summary: UT state law applies. Provo River Parkway trail allows Class 1/2 eBikes. Class 3 restricted to roads.

provisions.restrictions: Provo River Parkway: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Detroit
cities.summary: Follows state 3-class system. Permitted on Riverwalk with pedal-assist.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 restricted on trails.

cities.name: Grand Rapids
cities.summary: Michigan eBike law applies. Kent Trails and White Pine Trail allow Class 1/2. Class 3 on roads only on off-street paths.

provisions.restrictions: Kent Trails: Class 1/2 only; Class 3 roadways.

cities.name: Ann Arbor
cities.summary: MI state law applies. Huron River trail corridor allows Class 1/2. Natural area trails restrict all eBike classes.

provisions.restrictions: Natural area trails: eBikes prohibited. Paved paths: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Minneapolis
cities.summary: E-bikes treated as bicycles. Permitted on Midtown Greenway.

provisions.restrictions: Must yield to pedestrians on shared paths.

cities.name: St. Paul
cities.summary: MN state law applies. Same rules as Minneapolis. Grand Round Parkway trail allows Class 1/2.

provisions.restrictions: Grand Round: Class 1/2 only; yield to pedestrians.

cities.name: Milwaukee
cities.summary: Class 1 and 2 allowed on Oak Leaf Trail. Class 3 restricted.

provisions.restrictions: County parks prohibit throttle-only bikes on paths.

cities.name: Madison
cities.summary: WI state law applies. Capital City State Trail and Southwest Path allow Class 1/2. 10 mph advisory near pedestrians.

provisions.restrictions: Trail paths: 10 mph advisory near pedestrians; Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Kansas City
cities.summary: Missouri adopted 3-class eBike law (SB 617, 2022). KC follows state. Brush Creek Trail and KC trail network: Class 1/2 permitted. No city-specific additions beyond state law.

provisions.restrictions: Brush Creek Trail: Class 1/2 only; Class 3 on roadways.

cities.name: St. Louis
cities.summary: Follows state law. Treated similarly to traditional bicycles.

provisions.restrictions: Motorized bicycles require valid license.

cities.name: Springfield
cities.summary: Missouri state eBike law applies. Jordan Valley Park trail system allows Class 1/2.

provisions.restrictions: Trail system: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Nashville
cities.summary: Greenways accessible to Class 1 and 2 e-bikes at safe speeds.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 banned from greenways.

cities.name: Memphis
cities.summary: TN state eBike law applies. Memphis Greenline and Wolf River Greenway allow Class 1/2 at standard bicycle speeds.

provisions.restrictions: Greenline trail: Class 1/2 only; Class 3 on roadways.

cities.name: Knoxville
cities.summary: TN state law applies. Neyland Greenway allows Class 1/2. Urban Wilderness natural surface trails restrict eBikes entirely.

provisions.restrictions: Urban Wilderness natural trails: eBikes prohibited. Paved greenways: Class 1/2.

cities.name: Louisville
cities.summary: E-bikes permitted on shared-use paths. Local parks follow state laws.

provisions.restrictions: Follow 3-class system rules.

cities.name: Lexington
cities.summary: KY state eBike law applies. Legacy Trail and Town Branch Trail allow Class 1/2 eBikes.

provisions.restrictions: Trail system: Class 1/2 only; Class 3 on roadways.

cities.name: Atlanta
cities.summary: Permitted on the BeltLine. Yield to pedestrians required.

provisions.restrictions: 15 mph limit strictly enforced on BeltLine.

cities.name: Savannah
cities.summary: GA state law applies. Historic district squares and pedestrian zones restrict eBike access in high-foot-traffic areas.

provisions.restrictions: Historic district: eBikes not permitted on sidewalks or in squares; use streets.

cities.name: Charlotte
cities.summary: Prohibited on sidewalks in Uptown. State limits to 750W.

provisions.restrictions: No 3-class system; blanket 20mph limit.

cities.name: Raleigh
cities.summary: NC state law applies. Capital Area Greenway System (200+ miles): Class 1/2 permitted with 10 mph advisory near pedestrians.

provisions.restrictions: Greenway: Class 1/2 only; 10 mph near pedestrians.

cities.name: Durham
cities.summary: NC state law applies. American Tobacco Trail allows Class 1/2. No additional restrictions beyond state.

provisions.restrictions: American Tobacco Trail: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Charleston
cities.summary: Ordinance requires following traffic signals. E-bikes banned on sidewalks.

provisions.restrictions: Prohibited on Daniel Island multi-use paths.

cities.name: Columbia
cities.summary: SC state eBike law applies. Three Rivers Greenway allows Class 1/2. No city-specific additions beyond state.

provisions.restrictions: Three Rivers Greenway: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Virginia Beach
cities.summary: VA state law applies. Boardwalk: eBikes restricted to designated lanes with 8 mph limit when crowded. Class 3 must use Atlantic Ave roadway.

provisions.restrictions: Boardwalk: Class 1/2 with 8 mph limit; Class 3 prohibited on Boardwalk.

cities.name: Richmond
cities.summary: E-bikes permitted on Capital Trail and city bike lanes.

provisions.restrictions: 14+ age restriction for Class 3.

cities.name: Norfolk
cities.summary: VA state law applies. Elizabeth River Trail allows Class 1/2. Class 3 on roadways.

provisions.restrictions: Elizabeth River Trail: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Baltimore
cities.summary: Class 1/2/3 recognized. Permitted on bike lanes. Prohibited on sidewalks.

provisions.restrictions: Age 16+ for Class 3.

cities.name: Annapolis
cities.summary: MD state law applies. B&A Trail: Class 1/2 permitted. Historic downtown pedestrian areas restrict eBike access.

provisions.restrictions: Historic district pedestrian areas: eBikes prohibited.

cities.name: Indianapolis
cities.summary: Permitted on Monon Trail and Cultural Trail.

provisions.restrictions: Yield to pedestrians on all paths.

cities.name: Fort Wayne
cities.summary: Indiana state eBike law applies. Rivergreenway trail system allows Class 1/2 eBikes.

provisions.restrictions: Rivergreenway: Class 1/2 only; yield to pedestrians.

cities.name: Des Moines
cities.summary: Allowed on all paved city trails unless marked otherwise.

provisions.restrictions: Must operate with pedal-assist on paths.

cities.name: Cedar Rapids
cities.summary: Iowa state eBike law applies. Cedar River trail system allows Class 1/2. No city-specific restrictions beyond state.

provisions.restrictions: Trail system: Class 1/2 permitted.

cities.name: Wichita
cities.summary: Treated as traditional bicycles on roads and paths.

provisions.restrictions: Follow general traffic laws.

cities.name: Kansas City
cities.summary: Kansas state eBike law applies. Kansas City, KS (Wyandotte County) follows state 3-class system. No city-specific additions.

provisions.restrictions: Follow KS state 3-class system.

cities.name: Overland Park
cities.summary: Kansas law applies. Overland Park trail system (Mill Creek Streamway) allows Class 1/2 eBikes.

provisions.restrictions: Trail system: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Omaha
cities.summary: Allowed in bike lanes and on most city trails.

provisions.restrictions: Cannot be used on sidewalks in business districts.

cities.name: Lincoln
cities.summary: Nebraska state eBike law applies. Antelope Valley Trail and Mopac East Trail allow Class 1/2 eBikes.

provisions.restrictions: Trail system: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Sioux Falls
cities.summary: Class 1 and 2 allowed on the bike trail system.

provisions.restrictions: 15 mph limit on paved trails.

cities.name: Fargo
cities.summary: E-bikes treated as bicycles. 3-class system adopted.

provisions.restrictions: Follow statewide 3-class laws.

cities.name: Missoula
cities.summary: Allowed on paved commuter trails. Restricted on dirt paths.

provisions.restrictions: Check local park signage for dirt trails.

cities.name: Billings
cities.summary: Montana state eBike law applies. Billings Trail Network allows Class 1/2 eBikes on paved surfaces.

provisions.restrictions: Paved trails: Class 1/2 only; dirt trails: check signage.

cities.name: Boise
cities.summary: Allowed on Greenbelt. 15 mph speed limit strictly enforced.

provisions.restrictions: 15 mph on Greenbelt, polite passing required.

cities.name: Cheyenne
cities.summary: Allowed on greenway paths following 3-class system.

provisions.restrictions: Follow general bicycle regulations.

cities.name: Anchorage
cities.summary: Follows unique state law (motor-driven cycle definition).

provisions.restrictions: State considers them motor-driven cycles.

cities.name: Honolulu
cities.summary: Registered as bicycles. Required to have a license decal.

provisions.restrictions: Must pay $15 registration fee for decal.

cities.name: Little Rock
cities.summary: Adopted 3-class system. Allowed on River Trail.

provisions.restrictions: Age 16+ for Class 3.

cities.name: Fayetteville
cities.summary: AR state law applies. Razorback Regional Greenway (36 miles) allows Class 1/2 eBikes.

provisions.restrictions: Greenway: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: New Orleans
cities.summary: Treated as motorized bicycles. Permitted in bike lanes.

provisions.restrictions: Follow standard vehicle traffic laws.

cities.name: Baton Rouge
cities.summary: Louisiana state law applies. No additional local ordinances on file.

provisions.restrictions: Follow state law for motorized bicycles.

cities.name: Jackson
cities.summary: Follows 3-class system. Local ordinances may vary on trails.

provisions.restrictions: Follow state definitions.

cities.name: Birmingham
cities.summary: Adopted 3-class system. Allowed on most paved city paths.

provisions.restrictions: Age 16+ for Class 3.

cities.name: Huntsville
cities.summary: Alabama 3-class eBike law applies. Land Trust trail system: paved paths allow Class 1/2; natural surface trails restrict eBikes.

provisions.restrictions: Natural surface trails: eBikes prohibited. Paved paths: Class 1/2 only.

cities.name: Montgomery
cities.summary: Alabama state eBike law applies. No city-specific additions on file.

provisions.restrictions: Age 16+ for Class 3.

cities.name: Oklahoma City
cities.summary: Permitted on city trails following the 3-class model.

provisions.restrictions: Yield to pedestrians on trails.

cities.name: Tulsa
cities.summary: Oklahoma state eBike law applies. Tulsa River Parks trail system (100+ miles) allows Class 1/2 eBikes.

provisions.restrictions: River Parks trail: Class 1/2 only; yield to pedestrians.

cities.name: Charleston
cities.summary: E-bikes follow 3-class system. Treated as regular bicycles.

provisions.restrictions: Age 16+ for Class 3.

cities.name: Wilmington
cities.summary: Follows 3-class system. Not considered motor vehicles.

provisions.restrictions: Age 16+ for Class 3.

cities.name: Providence
cities.summary: E-bikes allowed on bike lanes and most paved paths.

provisions.restrictions: No specific local bans recorded.

cities.name: Manchester
cities.summary: 3-class system applies. Permitted on most roads.

provisions.restrictions: Class 3 restrictions on trails apply.

cities.name: Burlington
cities.summary: Allowed on local paths but subject to speed limits.

provisions.restrictions: Respect mixed-use path speed limits.

cities.name: Portland
cities.summary: E-bikes follow 3-class model. Allowed on most paved routes.

provisions.restrictions: Age 16+ for Class 3.
